gloss: dramatic reversal; big comeback; major turnaround

definitions.gloss: dramatic reversal; big comeback; major turnaround
definitions.explanation: A sudden and dramatic change of situation, especially from a losing or disadvantaged position to a winning one. Used in sports, games, business, and life situations.

examples.japanese: {九回|きゅうかい}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧{大逆転|だいぎゃくてん}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{起|お}きた→起きる：00521_okiru⟧。
examples.english: A dramatic comeback happened in the ninth inning.

examples.japanese: ⟦{誰|だれ}も→誰も：18610_daremo⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{諦|あきら}め→諦める：01813_akirameru⟧⟦かけた→かける：00854_kakeru⟧とき、{大逆転|だいぎゃくてん}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{起|お}こった→起こる：01910_okoru⟧。
examples.english: Just when everyone was about to give up, a dramatic turnaround occurred.

examples.japanese: ⟦{後半|こうはん}→後半：12555_kouhan⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧{三点|さんてん}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{取|と}って→取る：00565_toru⟧{大逆転勝|だいぎゃくてんが}ち⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{収|おさ}めた→収める：02022_osameru⟧。
examples.english: They scored three goals in the second half and pulled off a dramatic come-from-behind victory.

notes:
Compound of {大|だい} (great, major) + ⟦{逆転|ぎゃくてん}→逆転：06839_gyakuten⟧ (reversal). Intensified form of ⟦{逆転|ぎゃくてん}→逆転：06839_gyakuten⟧, emphasizing the dramatic nature of the turnaround.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {大逆転|だいぎゃくてん}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{起|お}きる→起きる：00521_okiru⟧: a big comeback occurs
- {大逆転勝|だいぎゃくてんが}ち: come-from-behind victory
- {大逆転負|だいぎゃくてんま}け: a dramatic loss after leading
- {大逆転|だいぎゃくてん}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{果|は}たす→果たす：10060_hatasu⟧: to achieve a major comeback
- {大逆転|だいぎゃくてん}⟦ホームラン→ホームラン：20814_hoomuran⟧: game-changing home run

USAGE:
Very common in sports broadcasting and commentary. Also used in business and everyday life to describe any situation where the outcome completely reverses expectations.

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{逆転|ぎゃくてん}→逆転：06839_gyakuten⟧: reversal — less dramatic intensity
- ⟦{番狂|ばんくる}わせ→番狂わせ：11067_bankuruwase⟧: upset — an unexpected result, especially when a weaker opponent wins
